curl -s --max-time 15 "https://api.telegram.org/bot8322308359:AAELtrV8BOvJu9LPEn775voLMjhJTM2iRyw/getWebhookInfo" 2>&1 | grep -o '"pending_update_count":[0-9]*'

TAIL_PID=$!
sleep 3

curl -s --max-time 60 "https://moltbot-sandbox.scott-james1717.workers.dev/sandbox-health" &

sleep 90 

kill $TAIL_PID 2>/dev/null
wait 2>/dev/null
